leftEvidence.title: The woman is built and brought to the man

points.label: Singular and plural language
points.left: The man names animals but finds no matching helper; God builds the woman, brings her to him, and the source moves into kinship, one flesh, and unashamed nakedness.
points.right: The genealogy recalls image, male and female, blessing, and the name Adam, then records Seth in Adam’s likeness, other children, nine hundred thirty years, and death.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Created, formed, and placed · core · Genesis 2:18–25
points.right: Children, generations, and death · core · Genesis 5:1–5

payload.posture: The woman is built, brought, recognized, and joined to the man is held beside Male and female are blessed and named Adam before the genealogy turns to Adam and Seth.

rightEvidence.title: Adam’s generations end with his death

payload.tension: Genesis 5 uses Adam collectively and individually inside one short genealogy.
payload.title: Woman, man, and the name Adam
